meta.task: Q198 read-only anatomy continuity / in-place audit of the six q197 pages

ct_block_seam.text: CT block seam: a measured structure is cut flat where its data block ends
ct_block_seam.fix: re-segment across the seam from the cryosection photographs / extend the measured structure with Z-Anatomy tendon+origin snapped to the model's own bones

bone_block_truncation.text: source block does not contain the whole bone (cut at the CT block edge)
bone_block_truncation.fix: re-measure the missing bone ends from the cryosection photographs, or complete the bone from the Z bone fitted to the surviving part

registration_mismatch.text: registration mismatch: structure transferred from another body is not tied to this body's own bones
registration_mismatch.fix: re-register the structure bone-driven (per-bone similarity + non-rigid refinement, Q194 method) and snap origins/insertions to the bone footprints

held_unrefined.text: held / unrefined structure: carried rigidly by a coarse transform, forearm/hand not refined
held_unrefined.fix: run the forearm/hand refinement (per-bone chain fit, Q195 hand/forearm queue)

blend_zone.text: blend zone between two frames (CT frame vs photograph frame) bridged by a long smooth blend
blend_zone.fix: refit the photographed arm into one frame (bones first, then soft tissue) instead of blending 100 mm

source_defect.text: source defect: already present in the unfitted Z-Anatomy original
source_defect.fix: cannot be fixed by fitting; local mesh repair of the Z object or accept as a known source limitation

not_modelled.text: structure not modelled in this reconstruction
not_modelled.fix: add from Z-Anatomy fitted to the bones, or segment from labels

skin_envelope.text: skin patches torn / removed (envelope not closed)
skin_envelope.fix: close the skin patches (shared-vertex weld after fitting) / re-add the deleted urogenital patches as a female surface

soft_vs_envelope.text: soft tissue not consistent with skin/bones of the same frame (different sources or frames)
soft_vs_envelope.fix: re-register the soft tissue to the skin/bones of the model; check the frame of each source block
